title: Webb County Approves New Tracking System for Medical Examiner’s Office
excerpt: Webb County commissioners approved a contract with Morgue Board LLC for a new system to track the deceased at the county Medical Examiner’s Office, at a cost of up to $12,800 a year, according to KGNS.
content:
Webb County commissioners on Monday approved a contract with Morgue Board LLC to set up a new system to track the deceased at the county Medical Examiner’s Office, according to KGNS.

The medical examiner said the software will change how the office checks in and releases bodies — and make the process the same every time.

The county will pay up to $12,800 a year for the system, with the money coming from the county’s software repairs and maintenance account.

The item was on the Commissioners Court agenda for Monday, Nov. 23, alongside the county’s application for a veterans treatment program grant of up to $400,000 — an agenda Webb Watch 956 covered when it was posted.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 26, 2026.
